Reply with ONE JSON object and NOTHING else: no prose
before or after it, no markdown code fences, no explanation.

{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "summary": "one line, at most 200 characters",
  "overview": "2-5 sentences of plain prose about this window; no headings, no bullets",
  "items": [{"db": "<database>", "status_line": "one line: what this database did"}],
  "open_incident_notes": [{"incident": 1, "note": "one line: what this window adds"}],
  "notable_analysis": [{"db": "<database>", "analysis": "3-10 sentences of markdown prose"}],
  "flags": ["anything a human should look at"]
}

Escalated-window rules (in addition to the rules above):
- "notable_analysis": exactly one entry per NOTABLE database listed above, and no other database.
- Compare this window against the Material only: prior occurrences of the same codes/groups, open incidents, error-class history. State only facts the Material shows.
- You may cite a wiki page in "analysis" only as a [[...]] wikilink that appears verbatim in the Material below; never invent one, and never link a page the Material does not show.
- Never declare recovery or a root cause the Material does not show — events stopping is not recovery.
- A "Database history" section is what that database did on earlier days: use it to say whether this window is new, recurring, or follows a recorded change; never cite it as evidence for this window.
